title: Random Splash Texts
description: This pack is as random as the icon! Revamp your splash texts with funny, meme or straight up random stuff including some secrets (that I made up).
body:
_This resource pack is pretty self-explanatory:_ It replaces the minecraft splash texts with many of my own, removed, special, or only available on certain platforms.

**The splashes can go from straight up randomness to pretty funny sometimes!**
